name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: Collateral-free loans up to ₹20 lakh (Shishu / Kishor / Tarun / Tarun Plus) for micro non-farm enterprises; priority & interest concessions for women
businessType: Non-farm, non-corporate micro enterprises (manufacturing, trading, services)
otherEligibility: Indian citizen; viable business plan; no loan default
regionalVariations: Uniform pan-India; higher uptake in southern & eastern states

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Bank loans ₹10 lakh–₹1 crore for greenfield enterprises by women (and SC/ST); one woman borrower per bank branch
otherEligibility: ≥51% ownership by woman/SC/ST; first-time entrepreneur; no default
regionalVariations: Uniform pan-India; no major regional subsidy difference

name: Prime Minister’s Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
description: Credit-linked subsidy (up to 35% for women) for new micro enterprises in manufacturing/services
introducedBy: Central Government (Ministry of MSME via KVIC)
ageGroup: 18+ years (special category up to 40 in some cases)
categoryPreference: Special category: Women, SC/ST, OBC, minorities, PwD, ex-servicemen (higher subsidy)
businessType: New micro enterprises (manufacturing up to ₹50L, services up to ₹20L)
otherEligibility: New unit only; EDP training required; own contribution 5–10%
regionalVariations: Special category (includes NER, Hill & Border areas, Aspirational Districts) gets 25% urban / 35% rural subsidy; higher capital limit in hilly areas

name: Trade Related Entrepreneurship Assistance and Development (TREAD)
description: Grant up to 30% of project cost + bank credit + training via NGOs for women in non-farm trade
otherEligibility: Through eligible NGOs; groups preferred
regionalVariations: Uniform; stronger outreach in rural & underserved regions

name: Mahila Coir Yojana
description: Training + 75% subsidy on coir spinning equipment for rural women artisans
introducedBy: Central Government (Ministry of MSME / Coir Board)
otherEligibility: Completed Coir Board training
regionalVariations: Restricted to Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Odisha, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Goa, West Bengal, Lakshadweep, A&N Islands, Puducherry, NER

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
description: Seed funding via incubators for early-stage startups; significant support to women-led
otherEligibility: ≥51% Indian promoters; not received >₹10L prior govt support
regionalVariations: Uniform pan-India; preference for NER & women-led in some cases

name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups (CGSS)
description: Collateral-free loan guarantees for startups; covers women-led
otherEligibility: Not in default/NPA; certified by Member Institution

name: Fund of Funds for Startups (FFS)
description: Capital to AIFs that invest in startups including women-led
otherEligibility: Via SEBI-registered AIFs; no direct individual application

name: DAY-NRLM / Lakhpati Didi
description: SHG mobilisation, credit, enterprise support to make rural women earn ≥₹1 lakh/year
otherEligibility: SHG member (10–20 women); BPL/poor household; one per family
regionalVariations: Implemented in all states/UTs except Delhi & Chandigarh; higher intensity in poorer/aspirational districts

name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
description: Higher guarantee cover (up to 90%) & fee relaxation for women-owned MSEs
categoryPreference: Higher cover for women (up to 90%), SC/ST, PwD
otherEligibility: Udyam registered MSE; through banks/NBFCs
regionalVariations: Higher guarantee coverage nationwide; additional 5% in Identified Credit Deficient Districts; enhanced terms for NER / J&K / Ladakh

name: ZED Certification Scheme
description: 100% free certification cost for women-led MSMEs
otherEligibility: Women-led MSME

name: PM Vishwakarma
description: Skill training, toolkit, credit support for traditional artisans (includes women)
otherEligibility: Unorganised sector; one per family; tools-based work

name: Udyam Sakhi Portal
description: One-stop digital platform for women entrepreneurs (schemes, training, funding info)
otherEligibility: Women seeking info/schemes/training

name: Udyogini Scheme
description: Subsidised bank loans up to ₹3 lakh (30–50% subsidy) for women in trade/services
otherEligibility: Karnataka resident; family income ≤₹1.5L (Gen)/₹2L (SC/ST); no limit for widows/disabled; no default
regionalVariations: Strictly limited to permanent residents of Karnataka

name: Mission Shakti Interest Subvention
description: 0% effective interest on SHG loans up to ₹3 lakh
otherEligibility: Mission Shakti SHG members

name: Stree Nidhi
description: Affordable credit for SHG-based women enterprises
otherEligibility: Stree Nidhi SHG members

name: Women in Startup Ecosystem (WISE) / KSUM Seed Support
description: Mentorship + seed funding for women-led startups
otherEligibility: Via Kerala Startup Mission

name: UP Mahila Udyam Nidhi Yojana
description: Low-interest (4%) loans ₹50,000–₹10 lakh for women micro/small enterprises
otherEligibility: UP domicile; family income <₹3L; viable plan

name: Mukhya Mantri Mahila Udyamita Abhiyaan (MMUA)
description: Seed capital ₹10,000 + subsidised loans for women entrepreneurs
otherEligibility: Assam women; progressive funding based on utilisation

name: SBI Stree Shakti Yojana
description: Loans up to ₹25 crore with interest concession (0.50% up to ₹2 crore) for women-owned businesses
otherEligibility: Women entrepreneurs; majority ownership preferred
